name: Surfside oceanfront condos?

acceptedAnswer.text: Surfside oceanfront condo buyers should examine direct beach access, view protection, building age and condition, amenities, association financials, assessments, insurance, and resale potential. Kelby Contreras assists with a property-specific comparison and purchase strategy.
